spans.s:
r. 1st cl. with an indicatory इ, अभि (अंभते)
To sound, (not generally admitted.)

Light.
2

Splendour.
3

Beauty.
E.
आङ् before भा to shine, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Not believing, not attached to.
E.
अ neg. भक्त attached.

m. (न्दः)
Want of appetite.
E.
अ neg. भक्त food, छन्द inclination.

f. (-रुक्)
Want of appetite.
E.
अ neg. भक्त food, रुच् inclination.

f. (-क्तिः)
Incredulity, unbelief, want of devotion to.
E.
अ neg. भक्ति faith.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Unbelieving, undevoted to.
E.
अ neg. भक्तिमत् believing.

n. (-णं)
1 Abstaining from, not eating any thing.
2 Fasting.
E.
अ neg. भक्षण eating.

mfn. (क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
Not to be eaten.
E.
अ neg. भक्ष्य to be eaten.

n. (-त्वं)
Unfitness as food.
E.
अभक्ष्य and त्व affix; also अभक्ष्यता.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Entire, unbroken.
2 Uninterrupted.
E.
अ neg. भग्न broken.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Unbroken, entire.
2 Undisturbed, uninterrupted.
E.
अ neg. भङ्गुर what breaks.

n. (-यं)
1 Absence or removal of fear.
2 The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
f. (-या)
Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia citrina.)
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fearless, undaunted.
E.
अ neg. and भय fear; the plant removing the dread of disease.

m. (-मः)
A war-drum.
E.
अभय, and डिण्डिम a drum: inspiring courage.

m. (-दः)
A protector, a defender.
mfn. (दः-दा-दं)
Removing fear or danger.
E.
अभय fearlessness, द who gives; also with प्र prefix अभयप्रद.

f. (णा)
Promise or present of protection from danger
E.
अभय, and दक्षिणा a gift to a Brahman, which, in this case he may receive from even a Śūdra.

n. (-नं)
Assurance of safety or protection.
E.
अभय and दान gift.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
One who grants safety.
E.
अभय fearlessness, प्रद who gives.

n. (-नं)
Assurance of safety, protection.
E.
अभय, and प्रदान giving.

f. (-वाक्)
Assurance of safety, encouragement.
E.
अभय, and वाच् speech.

m. (वः)
1 End of the world, liberation from the world.
2 Non-existence.
mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Non-existent.
E.
अ neg. भव being.

m. (-वः)
1 Non-existence, annihilation.
2

Death.
3

(In logic) Negation of two kinds, संसर्गाभाव universal negation, and अन्योन्याभाव relative or mutual negation.
4 (In rhetoric) Absence of the essential parts of poetical description of character, want of the properties or temperaments.
E.
अ priv. भाव being.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
What is not to be, what will not be.
E.
अ neg. भवितव्य to be.

f. (-ता)
Fate, predestined non-occurrence.
E.
अ neg. भवितव्य what is to be, तल् affix; also अभवितव्यत्वं.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Not to be, not predestined.
2 Improper, what ought not to be.
E.
अ neg. भव्य what is to be, also अभवनीय, &c.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Not sharing or dividing.
E.
अ neg. भाग a share.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Unfortunate, wretched.
E.
अ neg. भाग्य fortunate. So अभाग्यवत् (-वान्-वती-वत्)

f. (-ना)
1 Absence of judgment or right perception.
2 Absence of religious meditation or contemplation.
E.
अ neg. भावना perceiving.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not to be contemplated or inferred, uninferrible, inconceivable, unintelligible.
E.
अ neg. भावनीय to be perceived.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
1 What is not to be, what will not be.
2 Void of temperament or natural disposition.
E.
अ neg. भाविन् future, or having disposition.

n. (-णं)
Silence.
E.
अ neg. and भाषण speaking.

n. (-णं)
Addressing, speaking to.
E.
आङ्, भाष to speak, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Ornament, decoration, as jewels, &c.
2 Nourishing.
E.
आङ्, भृञ् to fill or nourish, ल्युट् aff.

Shade.
2

Light.
E.
आङ् before भा to shine, affix क्तिन्.

m. (-षः)
Introduction, preface.
E.
आङ् before भाष to speak, affix अच्.

Light.
2

Reflexion.
3

Intention, purpose.
4 (In logic) Fallacy, semblance of a reason, an argument that is erroneous though plausible: it is classed as of various kinds.
E.
आङ् before भास shining.

m. (-रः)
A demigod, of a class consisting of sixty-four.
E.
आङ्, भास to shine, वरच् aff.
